### Summary *(📌 required)*
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Reproduction Steps *(📌 required)*
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error.

### Environment *(📌 required)*
- Operating System with detailed version information
  - (e.g. Windows 11 24H2, Fedora Workstation 43, ...)
- LLM Qlient & tech stack version information

### Expected behavior *(➕ optional)*
A clear and concise description of what was expected to happen, if applicable.

### Screenshots or videos *(➕ optional)*
Additional attachments to help explain the problem, if applicable

### Additional context *(➕ optional)*
Add any other information that doesn't fit in any of the fields.
